policy: Version 2.3.0 of the engineering memory policy: everything 2.2.0 requires, plus the rule that the committed LESSONS.md is exactly the render of lessons.jsonl, regenerated with validate_lessons.py --render-index and never edited by hand. Under 2.2.0 every guardrail registry entry resolves its own kind and reference to a real control, through lessons.guardrail_entry_errors, the one function the effectiveness measure also asks. Under 2.1.0 a lesson's prose records the residual limit of its control and never contradicts its status; under 2.0.0 every GUARDED lesson names a registered guardrail, every control and evidence reference is resolved against the repository, and every lesson provenance locator must resolve against the checkpoint it cites. The guardrail registry lives at the fixed path .iacode/memory/guardrails/registry.json, resolved by lessons.guardrail_registry_path and by nothing else. A memory declaring an earlier version is read under the rules it declares, which is how sealed checkpoints stay valid under their own version.
